facts.title: quick, essential stovetop mac-and-cheese
ingredients: 4 ounces (115 grams) dried pasta, such as macaroni or another small twisty shape
2 teaspoons (10 grams) salted or unsalted butter
1/2 cup (125 ml) low-fat or whole milk
1/2 cup (1 ounce or 30 grams) finely grated parmesan or pecorino cheese
facts.author: Deb Perelman
